title: Pure Armored Xyz
summary: Armored Xyz is a Rank-climbing Xyz engine built around Xyz Armor Torpedo, Xyz Armor Fortress, and Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer. By using Level 3 WATER sharks and Goblin Biker Dugg Charger to assemble a Rank 3 Xyz, the deck draws cards, searches Armored Xyz Spells/Traps, and equips opposing monsters on the opponent's turn.

allow.Buzzsaw Shark: Targets a WATER monster to summon Right-Hand Shark or Lantern Shark from the Deck for an instant Rank 3/4/5 Xyz.
allow.Lantern Shark: Special Summons a Level 3, 4, or 5 WATER Fish from hand and modulates Levels for Xyz Summons.
allow.Surfacing Big Jaws: Special Summons itself after a Spell is activated and searches a Fish monster to make Rank 3 Xyz Armor Torpedo.
allow.Drake Shark: Special Summons itself when added to hand and counts as 2 materials for an Xyz Summon.
allow.Hydrojet Shark: Special Summons itself and sends Armored Xyz Spells/Traps to the GY to copy their effects.
allow.Goblin Biker Dugg Charger: Special Summons itself by detaching an Xyz Material on the field, serving as a free Level 3 extender.
allow.Aqua Jet Surface: Revives or Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Fish/Sea Serpent/Aqua and boosts ATK.
allow.Number 101: Silent Honor ARK: Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz that attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster as material.
allow.Submersible Carrier Aero Shark: Rank 3 WATER Xyz that detaches a material to enable Xyz Armor Fortress to rank up over it.
allow.Number 47: Nightmare Shark: Rank 3 WATER Xyz that detaches a material to attack directly and rank up into Xyz Armor Fortress.

main: Surfacing Big Jaws
Special Summons itself after a Spell activation and searches Buzzsaw, Lantern, or Hydrojet Shark.
Buzzsaw Shark
One-card Rank 3/4 Xyz starter that summons a Fish of the same Level from the Deck.
Lantern Shark
Extends from hand and modulates Levels between 3, 4, and 5 for Xyz Armor Torpedo or Fortress.
Hydrojet Shark
Special Summons itself and sends Armored Xyz or Full-Armored Xyz from Deck to GY to apply its effect.
Drake Shark
Special Summons itself when searched by Big Jaws to facilitate Rank 3 or Rank 4 plays.
Goblin Biker Dugg Charger
Detaches a material from Xyz Armor Fortress (enabling its rank-up condition) to Special Summon itself.
Armored Xyz
Equips an Xyz Monster from the GY to a monster on the field, changing its ATK/Attribute and granting a second attack.
Xyz Entrust
Searches any Armored Xyz card from the Deck or GY and modulates monster Levels to 3 or 5.
Aqua Jet Surface
Special Summons a Level 3/4 Shark from hand or GY to start Rank 3 Xyz plays.
Full-Armored Xyz
Trap that Xyz Summons on the opponent's turn and banishes from GY to equip an Xyz Monster for Lancer's suck effect.
Xyz Poseidon Splash
Trap that requires an Xyz with an Xyz Monster equipped to destroy all monsters of a declared Attribute.
extra: Rank 3 Xyz that detaches 2 materials to draw 1 card and grants Armades protection when equipped.
Rank 5 Xyz that ranks up over Rank 3/4 Xyz, detaches 1-2 materials to search 1-2 Armored Xyz cards, and doubles battle damage when equipped.
Rank 7 boss that ranks up over Rank 5/6 Xyz, recycles Armored Xyz cards, and equips an opponent's monster when an equip occurs.
Intermediate Rank 4 Xyz that ranks up over a 0-material Rank 3 WATER Xyz.
Rank 6 Xyz that ranks up over Rank 5 Xyz Armor Fortress.
Rank 4 WATER Xyz that attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster as material.
Rank 3 Xyz that detaches its own material so Xyz Armor Fortress can rank up over it immediately.
Rank 3 Xyz that detaches a material to burn and clear materials for Fortress.
